extDescription.message: Shows LLM translations below the original text (bilingual view)
extDescription.description: Extension description in the Chrome Web Store and chrome://extensions

pageLang.description: BCP 47 tag of this catalog's language, set as <html lang> (the UI language itself may be one with no catalog, e.g. fr, which falls back to English)

providerLabel.description: Provider with its model family, e.g. Anthropic (Claude)

modelOption.description: Model dropdown entry; note is one of the modelNote* messages

keyHintSaved.message: Saved. Paste a new key to replace it.
keyHintSaved.description: Placeholder of an API key field that already has a key

keyHintSavedTail.message: Saved ($tail$). Paste a new key to replace it.
keyHintSavedTail.description: Same, with the last characters of the saved key

popupWithShortcut.description: Button label followed by its keyboard shortcut

popupNoteRestrictedPages.message: Built-in browser pages and the Chrome Web Store don't allow extensions.

popupNoteNotAllowed.message: Chrome doesn't allow extensions to run on this page.

popupNoteNoShortcut.message: No shortcut is set. You can set one under "Shortcuts".

popupNoteNewModel.message: The new model will be used for segments translated from now on.

optionsModelHint.message: You only need the API key for the provider of the selected model.

optionsClearAria.description: Accessible name of a clear button; key is e.g. "Anthropic API key"

optionsKeyStorageHint.message: API keys are stored only in chrome.storage.local on this computer and are not synced through Chrome Sync. A saved key is never shown in full again and can't be copied from here. To replace a key, paste a new one; leave a field empty to keep the existing key.

optionsLimitsLead.message: We recommend creating a dedicated API key for this extension and setting a spending limit with the provider:
optionsLimitsLead.description: Followed by links to the three providers' limit pages

optionsDataNotice.message: When translating, the text of the segments to translate, the page title and the URL (domain and path only, no query string) are sent with your API key to the provider of the selected model (Anthropic, OpenAI or Google) and handled under that provider's API terms. Translations are cached on this computer and are not sent anywhere else.

optionsUiLangAuto.description: First option of the UI language select; language is that language's own name, e.g. Follow browser (English)

optionsUiLangHint.message: Applies right away. A tab that is already translated switches the next time it is toggled or shows an error. The extension's description on chrome://extensions and in the Chrome Web Store, and the shortcut descriptions on chrome://extensions/shortcuts, always follow the browser's language.

optionsUsage.message: How to use: click the extension icon to open the menu, or press the shortcut (default Alt/Option+A) to toggle translation. You can change shortcuts at chrome://extensions/shortcuts.

optionsActiveKeyLabel.description: Appended to the key field label of the provider the selected model uses

optionsSaved.message: Saved. Pages that are already open need translation toggled off and on again to use the new language.

optionsConfirmDeleteKey.message: Delete the API key for $provider$? You will need to paste it again to use it.

errNoTranslationParsed.message: The API responded, but no translation could be parsed

errKeyInvalid.message: $provider$ API key is invalid (401). Check it on the settings page

errForbidden.message: $provider$ API key has no access to this model (403): $detail$

errModelNotFound.message: $provider$ can't find the model (404). Check the model on the settings page

errRateLimit.message: $provider$ rate limit or quota exceeded (429). Try again later

errStreamEndedEarly.message: The stream ended before it completed

errAnthropicForbidden.message: API key has no access to this model (403)

errAnthropicModelNotFound.message: Model not found (404). Check the model on the settings page

errAnthropicRateLimit.message: Rate limit exceeded (429). Try again later

errMissedMaxTokens.message: The output hit the length limit, so this segment was cut off

errMissedRefusal.message: The model refused to translate this segment

contentConnectionLost.message: Connection to the background worker was lost

toastPageAlreadyTarget.message: This page already appears to be in $language$
toastPageAlreadyTarget.description: language is the target language's own name, e.g. English or 日本語

toastPageAlreadyTargetHint.message: To translate it anyway, choose another language under "Translate to" in the toolbar popup.

toastRetryHint.message: After fixing it, turn translation off and on again to retry the failed segments.

ytPlayerUnavailable.message: Can't connect to the YouTube player

ytReloadRetry.message: Reload the page, then turn on bilingual subtitles again.

ytLiveUnsupported.message: Subtitles for live streams aren't supported yet

ytNoneReceivedHint.message: Try pressing CC in the player to turn on captions, or reload the page.

ytAlreadyTarget.message: Subtitles are already in $language$, no translation needed
ytAlreadyTarget.description: language is the target language's own name, e.g. English or 日本語

ytAlreadyTargetHint.message: To translate subtitles in another language, choose that language in YouTube's subtitle menu.

ytFetchFailedHint.message: Choose the original language in YouTube's subtitle menu and try again.

ytRetryHint.message: After fixing it, turn bilingual subtitles off and on again to retry.

imageStatusDone.description: Chip on a translated image; count is the number of text regions

imageStatusPartial.description: Like imageStatusDone, when only the visible part of the image was translated

imageStatusFailed.description: Chip on an image whose translation failed; the reason is in a notice

imageShowOriginal.description: Chip button: hide the translation boxes

imageShowTranslation.description: Chip button: show the translation boxes again

imageRemove.description: Chip button: remove the translation from this image

toastImageFailed.description: Notice when image translation cannot run or fails; message is the reason

imageErrNeedAnthropicKey.message: Image translation needs an Anthropic (Claude) API key

imageErrIframe.message: Images inside an iframe are not supported yet

imageErrNotFound.message: Can't find this image on the page

imageErrNotVisible.message: Too little of the image is visible. Scroll so more of it is on screen, then try again

imageErrDeclined.message: The model declined to translate this image

optionsImageModel.description: Options page label for the model used to translate images

optionsImageModelHint.message: Right-click an image, or the page, to translate images. Image translation supports Claude only and uses the Anthropic API key. The image you see, or a screenshot of it, is sent to Anthropic.
